response: Saved Views is available today, giving you a faster way to return to the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on most. Instead of rebuilding a list from scratch every morning, save the setup once and reopen it with a single click. Saved Views is included in all paid plans, so every team already has access without an upgrade. Each user can save up to 50 views, covering personal boards, client projects, sprint backlogs, or anything else checked often. Views can also be shared with a team, so a manager's priority list or a support queue stays consistent for everyone who needs it, cutting down on duplicated setup work and mismatched filters. Whether you manage one project or dozens, this update keeps your most important lists close at hand and easy to find again, no matter how your workload changes week to week. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
